items.meaning: 本文档中出现的这些等级关键字应按照 [RFC2119] 中的定义来解释
220 回复码表示准备开始 TLS
501 回复码表示语法错误（不允许参数）
454 回复码表示由于临时原因 TLS 不可用
客户端收到 454 响应时必须决定是否继续 SMTP 会话
items.constraint: client must decide whether or not to continue the SMTP session
items.object: whether or not to continue the SMTP session
items.condition: If the client receives the 454 response

items.meaning: 公开引用的 SMTP 服务器不得要求使用 STARTTLS 扩展才能本地投递邮件
items.constraint: MUST NOT require use of the STARTTLS extension in order to deliver mail locally
items.object: the STARTTLS extension in order to deliver mail locally

items.meaning: 任何 SMTP 服务器可以基于 TLS 协商期间提供的认证拒绝接受中继邮件
items.object: messages for relay
items.condition: based on authentication supplied during the TLS negotiation

items.meaning: 非公开引用的 SMTP 服务器可以基于 TLS 协商期间提供的认证拒绝接受任何中继或本地投递邮件
items.object: any messages for relay or local delivery
items.condition: that is not publicly referenced

items.meaning: 未被公开引用的 SMTP 服务器可以选择要求客户端在接受任何命令之前先进行 TLS 协商
items.constraint: 服务器可要求先完成 TLS 协商再接受命令
items.object: that the client perform a TLS negotiation before accepting any commands
items.condition: A SMTP server that is not publicly referenced

items.meaning: 在上述情形下服务器应返回该应答码
items.constraint: 服务器应返回指定应答码
items.object: the reply code
items.condition: In this case

items.meaning: 应答码 530，其文本为 Must issue a STARTTLS command first
ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES 是 ESMTP 扩展（RFC2034）的名称
当双方使用 ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES 扩展时，应返回的状态码为 5.7.0
items.constraint: 应返回状态码 5.7.0
items.object: the status code 5.7.0
items.condition: If the client and server are using the ENHANCEDSTATUSCODES ESMTP extension [RFC2034]

items.meaning: 收到对 STARTTLS 命令的 220 响应后，客户端必须在发出任何其他 SMTP 命令之前开始 TLS 协商
items.constraint: 必须先开始 TLS 协商再发其他 SMTP 命令
items.object: the TLS negotiation
items.condition: After receiving a 220 response to a STARTTLS command

items.meaning: 若发出 STARTTLS 命令后发现某种失败使其无法真正开始 TLS 握手，客户端应中止连接
items.constraint: 应中止连接
items.object: the connection
items.condition: after having issued the STARTTLS command, the client finds out that some failure prevents it from actually starting a TLS handshake

items.meaning: 当客户端使用 RFC2920 定义的流水线时，STARTTLS 命令必须是一组命令中的最后一条
items.constraint: STARTTLS 命令须位于命令组的末尾
items.action: be the last command in a group
items.object: STARTTLS command
items.condition: If the SMTP client is using pipelining as defined in RFC 2920

items.meaning: TLS 握手完成后，双方必须立即基于所达成的认证与隐私状况决定是否继续
items.constraint: both parties MUST immediately decide whether or not to continue based on the authentication and privacy achieved
items.action: decide whether or not to continue
items.object: whether or not to continue based on the authentication and privacy achieved
items.condition: After the TLS handshake has been completed

items.meaning: 若 SMTP 客户端认为认证或隐私级别不足，应在 TLS 协商完成后立即发出 QUIT
items.constraint: it SHOULD issue an SMTP QUIT command immediately after the TLS negotiation is complete
items.object: SMTP QUIT command
items.condition: If the SMTP client decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue

items.meaning: 若 SMTP 服务器认为认证或隐私级别不足，应对每个非 QUIT 命令回复 554
items.constraint: it SHOULD reply to every SMTP command from the client (other than a QUIT command) with the 554 reply code
items.action: reply to every SMTP command from the client with the 554 reply code
items.object: every SMTP command from the client
items.condition: If the SMTP server decides that the level of authentication or privacy is not high enough for it to continue

items.meaning: TLS 握手后服务器必须丢弃并非来自 TLS 协商的客户端知识（如 EHLO 参数）
items.constraint: The server MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the client, such as the argument to the EHLO command, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.action: discard any knowledge obtained from the client
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the client, such as the argument to the EHLO command, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.condition: Upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: TLS 握手后客户端必须丢弃并非来自 TLS 协商的服务器知识（如扩展列表）
items.constraint: The client MUST discard any knowledge obtained from the server, such as the list of SMTP service extensions, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.action: discard any knowledge obtained from the server
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the server, such as the list of SMTP service extensions, which was not obtained from the TLS negotiation itself
items.condition: Upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: TLS 协商成功后客户端应把 EHLO 作为第一条命令发出
items.constraint: The client SHOULD send an EHLO command as the first command after a successful TLS negotiation
items.action: send an EHLO command as the first command
items.object: EHLO command
items.condition: after a successful TLS negotiation

items.meaning: TLS 握手后对 EHLO 返回的服务扩展列表可以不同于握手前返回的列表
items.constraint: The list of SMTP service extensions returned in response to an EHLO command received after the TLS handshake MAY be different than the list returned before the TLS handshake
items.action: be different than the list returned before the TLS handshake
items.object: the list of SMTP service extensions returned in response to an EHLO command
items.condition: received after the TLS handshake

items.meaning: 举例说明服务器可能不愿通告某 SASL 机制，除非客户端在 TLS 握手中发送了合适的客户端证书
SMTP 客户端，必须与服务器一同知晓当前是否存在活动的 TLS 会话
items.constraint: Both the client and the server MUST know if there is a TLS session active
items.object: if there is a TLS session active

items.meaning: SMTP 客户端，在 TLS 会话已激活时不得再尝试启动 TLS 会话
items.constraint: A client MUST NOT attempt to start a TLS session if a TLS session is already active
items.action: attempt to start a TLS session
items.object: TLS session
items.condition: if a TLS session is already active

items.meaning: STARTTLS 扩展，服务器在 TLS 握手完成后收到的 EHLO 响应中不得返回该扩展
items.constraint: A server MUST NOT return the STARTTLS extension in response to an EHLO command received after a TLS handshake has completed
items.object: the STARTTLS extension
items.condition: in response to an EHLO command received after a TLS handshake has completed

items.meaning: STARTTLS 是在 Submission 端口上有效的 ESMTP 扩展
SMTP 不是端到端机制
SMTP 服务器可认证 SMTP 客户端，但这并不意味着客户端收到的邮件经客户端认证
SMTP 客户端和服务器都必须检查 TLS 协商结果，以判断是否达到可接受程度的认证与隐私
items.constraint: Both the SMTP client and server must check the result of the TLS negotiation to see whether an acceptable degree of authentication and privacy was achieved
items.object: the result of the TLS negotiation

items.meaning: SMTP 客户端，TLS 协商结果的通知对象之一
items.constraint: should note carefully the result of the TLS negotiation
items.action: note carefully the result of the TLS negotiation
items.object: the result of the TLS negotiation

items.meaning: SMTP 会话中的客户端
items.constraint: the client may choose to end the SMTP session with an immediate QUIT command
items.action: end the SMTP session with an immediate QUIT command
items.object: the SMTP session
items.condition: If the negotiation results in no privacy, or if it results in privacy using algorithms or key lengths that are deemed not strong enough, or if the authentication is not good enough for either party

items.meaning: SMTP 会话中的服务器
items.constraint: the server may choose to not accept any more SMTP commands
items.action: not accept any more SMTP commands
items.object: SMTP commands
items.condition: If the negotiation results in no privacy, or if it results in privacy using algorithms or key lengths that are deemed not strong enough, or if the authentication is not good enough for either party

items.meaning: 服务器宣告的 SMTP 服务扩展能力，用于启动 TLS
服务器宣告的 STARTTLS 能力，可被中间人利用篡改客户端请求
SMTP 客户端，必须可被配置为要求成功的 TLS 协商
items.constraint: both clients and servers MUST be able to be configured to require successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts before messages can be successfully transferred
items.action: be able to be configured to require successful TLS negotiation
items.object: successful TLS negotiation of an appropriate cipher suite for selected hosts
items.condition: In order to defend against such attacks; before messages can be successfully transferred

items.meaning: 传输层安全协议，作为可能时使用的附加选项
items.constraint: The additional option of using TLS when possible SHOULD also be provided
items.object: the additional option of using TLS when possible

items.meaning: 实现，可提供记录 TLS 使用情况并告警的能力
items.constraint: An implementation MAY provide the ability to record that TLS was used in communicating with a given peer and generating a warning if it is not used in a later session
items.object: the ability to record that TLS was used in communicating with a given peer and generating a warning

items.meaning: 客户端在 TLS 协商过程中可能收到的响应码
SMTP 客户端，在失败或错误后应稍后重试 TLS
items.constraint: should try negotiate TLS in a later session, until some locally-chosen timeout occurs
items.action: try negotiate TLS in a later session
items.object: TLS
items.condition: If a failure or error occurs

items.meaning: SMTP 客户端，超时后应把邮件退回发件人
items.constraint: the client should return the mail to the sender
items.action: return the mail to the sender
items.object: the mail
items.condition: until some locally-chosen timeout occurs, at which point

items.meaning: SMTP 客户端，在 TLS 仅用于认证时可能继续会话
items.constraint: the client may want to proceed with the SMTP session
items.object: the SMTP session
items.condition: if the client and server were only using TLS for authentication

items.meaning: TLS 握手，开始之前的协议交互以明文进行并可能被主动攻击者修改
SMTP 客户端，必须在 TLS 握手完成时丢弃此前获得的知识
items.constraint: clients and servers MUST discard any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake upon completion of the TLS handshake
items.object: any knowledge obtained prior to the start of the TLS handshake
items.condition: upon completion of the TLS handshake

items.meaning: STARTTLS 扩展不适合用于认证邮件作者，除非投递链上每一跳（含递交到第一台 SMTP 服务器）都经过认证。
items.constraint: not suitable for authenticating the author of an email message unless every hop in the delivery chain, including the submission to the first SMTP server, is authenticated

items.meaning: SASL EXTERNAL 机制可以与 STARTTLS 命令结合使用，以提供授权身份（authorization identity）。
items.object: in conjunction with the STARTTLS command to provide an authorization identity

items.meaning: 参考文献条目：Freed, N. 的“SMTP Service Extension for Returning Enhanced Error Codes”（RFC 2034，1996 年 10 月）。
变更记录条目：第 5 节增加了关于服务器何时应发布、何时不应发布 STARTTLS 扩展的讨论。
该 SMTP 扩展允许 SMTP 客户端向服务器指出一种认证机制、执行认证协议交互，并可选地为本次会话后续协议交互协商安全层。
该扩展包含一份用于 SMTP 的 SASL 配置（profile）。
本文档定义 SMTP 扩展，使 SMTP 客户端可以向服务器指明认证机制并进行认证协议交换
相对 RFC 2554，本文档新增了支持用于准备授权身份的 SASLprep profile 的要求
本文档建议在 Received 跟踪头字段中使用 RFC 3848 传输类型
本文档中的规范等级关键词应按 [KEYWORDS] 所述解释
AUTH EHLO 关键字以空格分隔的参数列出可用 SASL 机制名称
可用机制列表在成功执行 STARTTLS 命令后可以改变
items.object: the list of available mechanisms
items.condition: after a successful STARTTLS command [SMTP-TLS]

items.meaning: An optional parameter using the keyword AUTH is added to the MAIL FROM command and extends the maximum line length of the MAIL FROM command by 500 characters.
An optional initial client response that, if present, MUST be encoded as described in Section 4 of [BASE64] or contain a single character "=".
items.constraint: If present, this response MUST be encoded as described in Section 4 of [BASE64] or contain a single character "=".
items.object: this response
items.condition: If present

items.meaning: After an AUTH command has been successfully completed, no more AUTH commands may be issued in the same session.
After a successful AUTH command completes, a server MUST reject any further AUTH commands with a 503 reply.
items.constraint: After a successful AUTH command completes, a server MUST reject any further AUTH commands with a 503 reply.
items.object: any further AUTH commands with a 503 reply
items.condition: After a successful AUTH command completes

items.meaning: The AUTH command is not permitted during a mail transaction.
An AUTH command issued during a mail transaction MUST be rejected with a 503 reply.
items.constraint: An AUTH command issued during a mail transaction MUST be rejected with a 503 reply.
items.object: An AUTH command issued during a mail transaction
items.condition: issued during a mail transaction

items.meaning: The AUTH command initiates a [SASL] authentication exchange between the client and the server.
The client identifies the SASL mechanism to use with the first parameter of the AUTH command.
If the server supports the requested authentication mechanism, it performs the SASL exchange to authenticate the client.
用于认证的命令；当请求的认证机制无效时，服务器以 504 回复拒绝该命令
items.constraint: 服务器在请求的认证机制无效（不支持或需要加密层）时以 504 回复拒绝 AUTH 命令

items.meaning: 服务器可支持的扩展；若支持则应当返回 5.5.4 增强响应码
items.constraint: 若服务器支持 [ESMTP-CODES] 扩展，则应返回 5.5.4 增强响应码
items.object: a 5.5.4 enhanced response code
items.condition: If the server supports the [ESMTP-CODES] extension

items.meaning: 服务器挑战，以 334 回复发送，其文本部分仅含 SASL 机制提供的 BASE64 编码串
items.constraint: 该挑战不得包含除 BASE64 编码挑战之外的任何文本
items.object: any text other than the BASE64 encoded challenge

items.meaning: 接收客户端取消响应的一方；收到该响应时必须拒绝 AUTH 命令
items.constraint: 若服务器收到含单个 "*" 的响应，必须通过发送 501 回复拒绝 AUTH 命令
items.action: reject the AUTH command by sending a 501 reply
items.object: AUTH command
items.condition: If the server receives such a response

items.meaning: 带有可选初始响应参数的命令，用于在使用支持初始客户端响应的机制时省去一次往返
在初始响应参数被省略而所选机制要求初始客户端响应时，须按 [SASL] 第 5.1 节处理的一方
items.constraint: 若省略初始响应参数且所选机制要求初始客户端响应，服务器必须按 [SASL] 第 5.1 节所定义的方式处理
items.action: proceed as defined in Section 5.1 of [SASL]
items.object: initial client response handling
items.condition: If the initial response argument is omitted and the chosen mechanism requires an initial client response

items.meaning: 该命令仍受 [SMTP] 定义的行长度限制约束
在初始响应参数会使 AUTH 命令超出行长度限制时，不得使用该参数的一方
items.constraint: 若使用初始响应参数会导致 AUTH 命令超出行长度限制，客户端不得使用该初始响应参数
items.object: the initial response parameter
items.condition: If use of the initial response argument would cause the AUTH command to exceed this length

items.meaning: If the client is sending an initial response of zero length, it must instead send the response as a single equals sign ('=').
items.constraint: If the client is transmitting an initial response of zero length, it MUST instead transmit the response as a single equals sign ("=").
items.object: the response as a single equals sign ("=")
items.condition: If the client is transmitting an initial response of zero length

items.meaning: If the client uses an initial-response argument with a SASL mechanism in which the client does not begin the exchange, the server must reject the AUTH command with a 501 reply.
items.constraint: The server MUST reject the AUTH command with a 501 reply if the client uses an initial-response argument to the AUTH command with a SASL mechanism in which the client does not begin the authentication exchange.
items.object: the AUTH command with a 501 reply
items.condition: If the client uses an initial-response argument to the AUTH command with a SASL mechanism in which the client does not begin the authentication exchange

items.meaning: Servers using the enhanced status codes extension should return enhanced status code 5.7.0 in this case.
items.constraint: Servers using the enhanced status codes extension [ESMTP-CODES] SHOULD return an enhanced status code of 5.7.0 in this case.
items.object: an enhanced status code of 5.7.0
items.condition: using the enhanced status codes extension [ESMTP-CODES]; in this case

items.meaning: If the server cannot BASE64-decode any client response, it must reject the AUTH command with a 501 reply and enhanced status code 5.5.2.
items.constraint: If the server cannot [BASE64] decode any client response, it MUST reject the AUTH command with a 501 reply (and an enhanced status code of 5.5.2).
items.object: the AUTH command with a 501 reply (and an enhanced status code of 5.5.2)
items.condition: If the server cannot [BASE64] decode any client response

items.meaning: If the client cannot BASE64-decode any of the server's challenges, it must cancel authentication using the '*' response.
items.constraint: If the client cannot BASE64 decode any of the server's challenges, it MUST cancel the authentication using the "*" response.
items.object: the authentication using the "*" response
items.condition: If the client cannot BASE64 decode any of the server's challenges

items.meaning: Servers and clients must reject, not ignore, characters outside the BASE64 alphabet and BASE64 sequences with a pad character not at the end.
items.constraint: Servers and clients MUST reject (and not ignore) any character not explicitly allowed by the BASE64 alphabet, and MUST reject any sequence of BASE64 characters that contains the pad character ('=') anywhere other than the end of the string.
items.object: any character not explicitly allowed by the BASE64 alphabet, and any sequence of BASE64 characters that contains the pad character ('=') anywhere other than the end of the string
items.keyword_raw: MUST reject (and not ignore) ... and MUST reject
items.condition: In particular

items.meaning: Clients and servers must be able to handle the maximum encoded size of challenges and responses generated by their supported authentication mechanisms.
items.constraint: Clients and servers MUST be able to handle the maximum encoded size of challenges and responses generated by their supported authentication mechanisms.
items.object: the maximum encoded size of challenges and responses generated by their supported authentication mechanisms

items.meaning: If during an authentication exchange the server receives a line longer than its authentication buffer, the server fails the AUTH command with a 500 reply.
items.constraint: If, during an authentication exchange, the server receives a line that is longer than the server's authentication buffer, the server fails the AUTH command with the 500 reply.

items.meaning: Servers using the enhanced status codes extension should return enhanced status code 5.5.6 in this case.
items.constraint: Servers using the enhanced status codes extension [ESMTP-CODES] SHOULD return an enhanced status code of 5.5.6 in this case.
items.object: an enhanced status code of 5.5.6
items.condition: using the enhanced status codes extension [ESMTP-CODES]; in this case

items.meaning: 由 SASL 交换生成的授权身份，是一个“简单用户名”
用于在传输或比较前准备名称的 StringPrep 算法配置文件
items.constraint: client 与 server 应使用 SASLprep 配置文件准备这些名称
items.object: the [SASLprep] profile of the [StringPrep] algorithm to prepare these names for transmission or comparison

items.meaning: 在授权身份准备失败时执行认证失败的一方
items.constraint: 若授权身份准备失败或结果为空串（除非它本来就是作为空串传输的），server 必须使认证失败
items.object: the authentication
items.condition: If preparation of the authorization identity fails or results in an empty string
items.exception: (unless it was transmitted as the empty string)

items.meaning: 注释说明本规范的未来修订可能将该要求改为 MUST，当前使用 SHOULD 以避免破坏大多数现有实现
SMTP 认证命令，被拒绝时返回 535 应答
items.constraint: 若 server 无法认证 client，应以 535 应答拒绝 AUTH 命令
items.object: the AUTH command with a 535 reply
items.condition: If the server is unable to authenticate the client
items.exception: unless a more specific error code is appropriate

items.meaning: 客户端成功完成交换时 SMTP server 发出的应答码
在 SASL 交换中协商出的安全层，其生效时刻对 client 与 server 分别定义
items.constraint: 对 client 在终结其最后一个响应的 CRLF 之后的下一个八位组起生效；对 server 在其成功应答的 CRLF 之后立即生效

items.meaning: EHLO 参数是 server 从 client 获得的、可被丢弃的知识示例
items.constraint: 安全层生效时 server 必须丢弃任何从 client 获得、且非来自 SASL 协商本身的知识
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the client, such as the EHLO argument, which was not obtained from the SASL negotiation itself
items.condition: When a security layer takes effect

items.meaning: 在安全层生效后必须丢弃非 SASL 协商所得知识的另一方
items.constraint: 安全层生效时 client 必须丢弃任何从 server 获得、且非来自 SASL 协商本身的知识
items.object: any knowledge obtained from the server, such as the list of SMTP service extensions, which was not obtained from the SASL negotiation itself
items.condition: When a security layer takes effect

items.meaning: client 可比较认证前后公布的 SASL 机制以检测主动降级攻击
items.constraint: client 可比较认证前后公布的 SASL 机制
items.object: the advertised SASL mechanisms before and after authentication in order to detect an active down-negotiation attack

items.meaning: 客户端在成功完成启用安全层的 SASL 协商后，应发送 EHLO 命令作为第一条命令。
items.constraint: 客户端应在成功完成启用安全层的 SASL 协商后，将 EHLO 命令作为第一条命令发送。
items.object: EHLO command as the first command
items.condition: after a successful SASL negotiation that results in the enabling of a security layer

items.meaning: 当实体发送数据且 TLS 和 SASL 安全层均生效时，TLS 编码必须在 SASL 编码之后应用。
items.constraint: 当实体发送数据且 TLS 和 SASL 安全层均生效时，必须将 TLS 编码应用在 SASL 编码之后。
items.object: TLS encoding after the SASL encoding
items.condition: When an entity (whether it is the client or the server end) is sending data, and both [TLS] and SASL security layers are in effect

items.meaning: 如果 AUTH 命令失败，客户端可以不经认证继续。
items.constraint: 如果 AUTH 命令失败，客户端可以不经认证继续。
items.object: without authentication
items.condition: If an AUTH command fails

items.meaning: 如果 AUTH 命令失败，客户端可以尝试另一种认证机制，或通过发出另一个 AUTH 提供不同凭据。
items.constraint: 如果 AUTH 命令失败，客户端可以尝试另一种认证机制，或通过发出另一个 AUTH 提供不同凭据。
items.action: try another authentication mechanism or present different credentials by issuing another AUTH
items.object: another authentication mechanism or different credentials
items.condition: If an AUTH command fails

items.meaning: 服务器实现必须实现一种配置，这种配置不允许任何明文密码机制，除非已协商 STARTTLS 或已提供其他保护机制。
items.constraint: 服务器实现必须实现一种配置，在这种配置中它不允许任何明文密码机制，除非已协商 STARTTLS 命令或已提供其他保护会话免遭密码窥探的机制。
items.object: in which it does NOT permit any plaintext password mechanisms
items.exception: unless either the STARTTLS [SMTP-TLS] command has been negotiated or some other mechanism that protects the session from password snooping has been provided
